Flow.description: DIR-869: RES_Approval_Request_Remarks__c and Comments are kept on separate paths by design - the field name means it's for the approval REQUEST (context about what's being asked, e.g. the bell-notification text set on insert), not the decision. Comments is the approver's own decision remark, written only by the native approval screen - never touched by automation. Once the approver decides (Status becomes Approved/Rejected), this clears Remarks back to blank so field history tracking on it shows a clean request-then-resolved story instead of overlapping with Comments' own separate history.
